blocks.text: La Paz City Tour & Valley of the Moon

provenance.rationale: Remove the day number, which the itinerary renders separately from the title.

blocks.text:
At 14:30, enjoy a private half-day tour of the most interesting sites in the city of La Paz. The Killi Killi viewpoint offers stunning photographs of the city. Then, visit the historic center of La Paz, Plaza Murillo, Executive Palace, Legislative Palace, and the Metropolitan Cathedral. Heading to the amazing Valley of the Moon, you'll see the replica of the semi-underground temple of Tiwanaku located in front of the city's stadium.

Arrive at the Valley of the Moon with astonishing clay geological formations created by the erosion of winds and heavy rains, forming an attractive lunar landscape. On the way back to the city center, take the yellow cable car line to enjoy a beautiful panorama of La Paz. This urban cable car is one of the most picturesque means of urban cable transportation, allowing you to discover the secrets of the city from the air and admire the snow-capped Illimani mountain. Continue the tour to the Witches' Market, a place full of traditions and objects for ancient Andean rituals, craft markets where you can feel the heartbeat of this charming city. The tour ends at the Church of San Francisco, a majestic colonial church in Mestizo Baroque style. Return to the hotel.
